newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brown Bros ups big banks ratings.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brown Bros ups big banks ratings.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers Harriman analyst Ray Soifer said he raised his short-term ratings on several big banks.
-- said upgraded J.P. Morgan & Co Inc to short-term buy from hold.
-- raised Chase Manhattan Corp, BankAmerica Corp and Citicorp to short-term trading buy from market perform.

-- cited the firm's upgrading of short-term outlook for bonds to bullish from neutral, and said firm's director of financial analysis, Charles Blood, expects long-term Treasury yield now about 6.82 percent, to approach 6.50 percent within next one to three months.
-- said near-term market environment should also be favorable to performance of financial stocks, especially large-cap banking issues.
-- short-term price target for Morgan is in upper $100s, while long-term target is $110-$115. Price targets for BankAmerica is $110, $114 for Citicorp, and $97 for Chase.
-- Morgan shares fell 5/8 to 101-7/8, Citicorp rose 1-1/4 to 109-3/8, Chase gained 3/4 to 92-7/8, and BankAmerica was up 1/2 to 107-3/8.
